name: SoRT Scope Builder
tagline: Builds SORT Forum remediation scope tables for field stations and copies them straight into Word.
about: A single-page tool used at SORT Forums to click through a station's remediation scope — the questions for its station type, a Property Services table and a site map — and paste the finished tables into Word. The questions live in definitions.json in this repository, which is the source of truth: editors change them in the app and Publish to GitHub. A v2 beta runs beside v1: one flowing page that looks the station up in Flood-Net, saves sessions in the browser and puts the map on the page.

components.name: Scope Builder (v1)
components.what: The live app: pick a station type, fill the rows, Copy table for Word; Manage Tables and Table Map edit the definitions in place.

components.name: Definitions (v1)
components.what: Every table, row and option, read from GitHub on start; Publish to GitHub commits edits back, so its history is the audit trail and the rollback.

components.name: Property Services table
components.what: A second table copied into Word under the scope, pre-filled from the scope's coordinates and relocation answer, with its own editor tab.

components.name: Site Map (v1)
components.what: A modal map of the table's pins over Queensland Government imagery, LiDAR contours, the road reserve and rail, with pin write-back and a picture captured for Word.

components.name: Scope Builder v2 (beta)
components.what: One flowing page — forum, station, map, questions, Property Services, follow-ups, preview and Copy for Word — with answers saved in the browser as sessions.

components.name: v2 question bank
components.what: One question bank with permanent codes, four station-type templates, and conditions and follow-up rules as data; checked by the page and by a Node tool before use.

components.name: Flood-Net station lookup
components.what: Searches Flood-Net's read-only API and pre-fills name, number, ALERT IDs, frequency, current comms, repeater details and ACMA licences, marked until confirmed.

components.name: v2 map
components.what: The map on the page: QLD imagery, contours, road reserve and rail; survey marks from the State's control register and bridges from TMR and QLD Roads and Tracks; Flood-Net stations within 3 km.

components.name: Browser tests
components.what: Playwright regression tests that drive the real v1 page in headless Chromium: map framing, pin write-back, Word geometry, GitHub publishing.

components.name: Retired Supabase store
components.what: The last dump of the old definitions database and the script that rebuilds definitions.json from it, kept for the record.

provides.name: QLD Globe map layer recipes
provides.what: Which Queensland Government ArcGIS services and sublayers draw imagery, LiDAR contours (resolved by name), the road reserve, rail and survey marks, and how they are styled. Flood-Net's contour and survey-mark layers were ported from it.

consumes.what: Flood-Net's public read-only agent API: station search and stations near a point, each station's dossier and record, and the ACMA licences at its site.
consumes.on_change: Read the new docs/api-changelog.json entries; if a route or field SoRT reads changed, update v2/js/floodnet.js, bump v2's ?v= stamp and look up a station on /SoRT/v2/.
